09 / THE USEFUL LITTLE DETAILS

A few things
worth knowing.

Keep the planning simple. If you are unsure about any detail, we are happy to talk it through.

How do I confirm a bundle?

Choose a bundle, build your estimate, and use the enquiry link or contact page to discuss it with the team. Saving a plan stores your selection on this device; it does not place an order or reserve a table.

Can the contents be adjusted?

Please ask before ordering. Ingredient swaps, serving sizes, and dietary requests depend on what the kitchen can accommodate and may affect the price.

How does the planner code work?

TOGETHER10 previews a 10% reduction on the bundle subtotal in this planner. It is not a completed transaction or a guarantee of a discount. Confirm the applicable offer with the restaurant.

What about allergies and extra charges?

Tell the team about allergies before choosing. Any applicable taxes, service, packaging, or other charges should be confirmed with the restaurant before you commit to an order.
